blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Masked diffusion language models offer parallel text generation, but independently sampling multiple tokens can disrupt their dependencies and change the output distribution. Exact continuous-time sampling avoids this approximation, yet typically requires one sequential model evaluation per token. We introduce SpecCTMC, a training-free speculative sampler that reduces this sequential bottleneck without a separate draft model. SpecCTMC proposes successive token updates using previously computed model predictions, evaluates their intermediate states in parallel, and applies an exact acceptance-and-correction procedure. We prove that SpecCTMC preserves the joint distribution of event times, generation order, and token values of the underlying continuous-time Markov chain. It therefore introduces neither time-discretization error nor additional factorization error from parallel decoding. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B across five benchmarks demonstrate 1.73-4.38x fewer sequential model evaluations than direct continuous-time sampling, while preserving the reference sampling distribution. Our code is available at: https://github.com/kasakh/specctmc
blocks.zh: 蒙面扩散语言模型提供并行的文本生成,但独立地取样多个符号可以破坏它们的依赖性,改变输出分布. 精确的连续时间采样避免了这种近似现象,但通常需要每个符号一个顺序模型评价. 我们引进了SpecCTMC, 一个没有训练的投机性采样器, 减少这种连续的瓶颈, 没有单独的模型草稿。 SpecCTMC采用之前计算过的模型预测,连续提出符号更新,同时评价其中间状态,并采用精确的接受和校正程序. 我们证明SpecCTMC保留了事件时间的联合分布,生成顺序,以及基础连续时间马尔科夫链的象征值. 因此,它既不引入时间分解错误,也不引入平行解码的额外要素化错误. 关于LLaDA-8B-指示和Dream-v0-指示7B的五个基准实验显示,相继进行的模型评价比直接连续取样少1.73-4.38x,同时保留了参考抽样分布。 我们的代码见:https://github.com/kasakh/spectmc。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Masked diffusion language models (MDLMs) generate text by iteratively unmasking tokens in a partially masked sequence, allowing generation beyond a fixed left-to-right order ( Sahoo et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2024 ; Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . This flexibility offers opportunities for parallel inference, but realizing them without compromising generation quality remains challenging. In the continuous-time formulation, the reverse process is a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) that unmasks one token at each event ( Campbell et al., 2022 ) . Direct simulation therefore requires a sequence of model evaluations, with each update depending on previously unmasked tokens. Reducing this sequential cost is central to making exact sampling of diffusion language models practical.
blocks.zh: 遮盖扩散语言模型(MDLMs)通过部分遮盖序列的迭代解码来生成文本,允许超出固定的左到右顺序的生成(Sahoo等,2024;Shi等,2024;Nie等,2025;Ye等,2025). 这种灵活性为平行推论提供了机会,但在不损害发电质量的情况下实现这些推论仍然具有挑战性。 在连续时间配制中,倒转过程是一个连续时间的马可夫链(CTMC),每次事件会解开一个符号(Campbell等,2022.). 因此,直接模拟需要一系列的模型评价,每次更新都取决于以前未显示的标志。 减少这种相继发生的成本,对于准确取样传播语言模型具有核心意义。

blocks.en: Existing approaches reduce inference cost through numerical approximation, decoding heuristics, and computation reuse. Numerical samplers such as τ \tau -leaping approximate multiple transitions within a time interval, while higher-order methods, including the θ \theta -trapezoidal solver, improve the accuracy of this approximation ( Campbell et al., 2022 ; Lou et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2025 ) . Practical decoders also use greedy token selection and confidence-based unmasking orders to generate high-quality text with fewer denoising steps ( Nie et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . Fast-dLLM combines confidence-guided parallel decoding with approximate KV caching ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , and Fast-dLLM++ uses the full token-confidence profile to select larger groups of tokens for simultaneous commitment ( Kasa et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过数字近似、解码热量和计算再利用来降低推论成本。 数字采样器,如\tau-在一个时间间隔内释放出近似多段过渡,而更高顺序的方法,包括\theta-trapzoidal解析器,提高了这种近似的准确性(Campbell等人,2022;Lou等人,2024;Ren等人,2025)。 实用解码器还使用贪婪的符号选择和基于信心的解码命令来生成高质量的文本并减少去名步骤(Nie等,2025;Ye等,2025.). Fast-dLLM结合了信心导出并列解码与相近KV缓存(Wu等,2026年),而Fast-dLLLM++则使用全符-自信剖面来选择更大组符来同时承诺(Kasa等,2026年).

blocks.en:
A central challenge in MDLMs is that tokens predicted from the same partially masked sequence are often not conditionally independent. Unmasking one token can change the distribution of another, so sampling several positions independently can result in a different distribution from updating them sequentially. This factorization error underlies the curse of parallel decoding discussed in previous works like Wu et al. (2026) ; Kasa et al. (2026) .
Separately, the denoiser’s conditional predictions across different masking contexts need not be compatible with a single joint distribution ( Young et al., 2024 ; Torroba Hennigen and Kim, 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
MDLMs中的一项中心挑战是,从同一个被部分遮掩的序列中预言的符号往往不有条件地独立. 取出一个符符可以改变另一个符符符的分布,因此独立地采样出几个位可以产生不同的分布与相继更新. 这种因子化错误是前几作中讨论的平行解码诅咒的基础,例如:Wu等 (2026年);Kasa等 (2026年).
另外,Denoiser对不同遮掩背景的有条件预测与单一联合分布并不相容(Young等,2024;Torroba Hennigen和Kim,2023)。

blocks.en: The choice of decoding policy also matters when generation is used to explore multiple candidate answers. Greedy decoding can be effective for producing a single answer, but a fully deterministic decoder cannot explore alternative solutions through repeated runs. Even with stochastic token sampling, confidence-based unmasking orders can restrict diversity and limit improvements from additional samples ( Olausson et al., 2026 ) . For reasoning and code generation, this motivates evaluating solution coverage across multiple attempts alongside single-sample accuracy, and accelerating stochastic generation while preserving its sampling distribution.
blocks.zh: 编解码政策的选择在使用生成来探索多个候选答案时也很重要. 贪婪的解码可以有效生成一个答案,但完全决定性的解码器无法通过重复运行来探索替代解决方案. 即使是有花样的标志性取样,基于信心的脱口令也可以限制多样性并限制对额外样品的改进(Olausson等,2026年). 就推理和代码生成而言,这促使人们评估多重尝试的溶液覆盖范围,同时评估单一样本的准确性,并加速分层生成,同时保持其抽样分布。

blocks.en: Exact event-driven simulation provides a principled reference for this goal. Gillespie’s stochastic simulation algorithm samples individual transitions at random event times ( Gillespie, 1977 ) , and sequential first-hitting sampling applies this principle to absorbing-mask diffusion ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . After each position is unmasked, the model conditions the next update on the resulting sequence. This introduces neither time-discretization error nor the additional factorization error caused by committing independent token updates together. Its computational cost, however, remains dominated by sequential model evaluations.
blocks.zh: 精确的事件驱动模拟为这一目标提供了原则性参考. Gillespie的分型模拟算法在随机事件时间(Gillespie,1977年)对单个过渡进行抽样,相继的先发式抽样应用了这一原则来吸收-面具扩散(Zheng等,2025年). 在每个位置被解开后,模型会为由此产生的序列的下一次更新提供条件. 这既不引入分时错误,也不引入将独立符号更新合并起来而导致的额外因子化错误. 然而,其计算成本仍然以相继进行的模型评价为主。

blocks.en: To address these key bottlenecks, we introduce SpecCTMC , a training-free speculative sampler that reduces this sequential evaluations without the need for a separate draft model. Our approach builds on distribution-preserving speculative sampling for autoregressive (AR) language models ( Leviathan et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) and its extension to continuous diffusion models ( Bortoli et al., 2025 ) . Speculative methods have also been developed for finite-step diffusion language model decoders ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . Here, we instead target the underlying absorbing-mask CTMC, including its random event times and the joint selection of token positions and values.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些关键的瓶颈问题,我们引入了SpecCTMC(无培训投机抽样),减少这种相继进行的评价,而不需要单独的模式草案。 我们的方法基于自递性语言模型的分布保留投机性取样(Leviathan等,2023;Chen等,2023)及其延伸至持续扩散模型(Bortoli等,2025)。 还为有限步骤扩散语言模型解码器开发了分光方法(Agrawal等,2026;Pan等,2026)。 在这里,我们针对的是基本的吸收-面具CTMC,包括它的随机事件时间和共同选择象征位置和价值。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 1 , the key observation is that, for the absorbing-mask generators considered here, event times depend on diffusion time and the number of remaining masks, independently of the identities of unmasked tokens. These times can therefore be sampled in advance and preserved when a proposed token update is rejected and corrected. SpecCTMC reuses previously computed model predictions to propose successive updates, evaluates their intermediate sequences in parallel, and applies an exact acceptance-and-correction procedure. We prove that the resulting trajectory has the same joint distribution of event times, token positions, and token values as direct simulation.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,关键观察是,对于本文中考虑的吸收-掩体发电机,事件时间取决于扩散时间和所剩口罩数量,而不考虑未蒙面的相片的身份. 因此,这些时间可以预先抽样,当提议的符号更新被拒绝并被更正时可以保留. SpecCTMC复用之前计算出模型预测,以提出相继更新,并行评价其中间序列,并应用精确的接受和校正程序. 我们证明,由此产生的轨迹具有与直接模拟相同的事件时间、象征位置和象征值的联合分布。

blocks.en: Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B across five benchmarks show that SpecCTMC uses 1.73-4.38 × \times fewer sequential target-model evaluations than direct simulation, with measured wall-clock speedups of up to 2.88 × \times on an NVIDIA B200. On GSM8K, multiple stochastic attempts solve questions missed by deterministic greedy denoising, and SpecCTMC reduces their cumulative sequential-evaluation cost relative to DirectCTMC. As shown in Figure 2 , by reducing the number of sequential evaluations, SpecCTMC addresses a cost complementary to optimizations that make each evaluation cheaper. In particular, cached or otherwise approximate predictions can be used for drafting while exact target verification preserves the CTMC sampling distribution.
blocks.zh: 跨越五个基准的LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-v0-Instruct-7B的实验表明,SpecCTMC使用1.73-4.38 ×相继目标模型评价的时间比直接模拟少,所测量的壁时速度可达 2.88 ×\相继在NVIDIA B200上. 在GSM8K上,多场有花样的尝试解决了被决定性地贪婪地去Noing所错过的问题,而SpecCTMC相对DirectCTMC减少了其累积相继评价成本. 如图2所示,通过减少相继评价的数量,SpecCTMC解决了对优化成本的补充,使每次评价更便宜。 特别是,可使用缓存预测或其他近似预测来起草,而精确的目标核查则保留CTMC取样分布.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Discrete diffusion admits a continuous-time Markov chain formulation with random state transitions ( Campbell et al., 2022 ) . For absorbing-mask models, sequential first-hitting sampling draws each unmasking time and then updates one token ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; DirectCTMC instantiates this exact event-driven reference. Parallel first-hitting sampling uses the sampled event times but freezes token predictions across several updates, so exact clocks alone do not preserve the transition law. Uniformization instead obtains exact simulation from a common candidate clock and virtual self-transitions ( Chen and Ying, 2024 ) , whereas tau-leaping and higher-order solvers approximate the dynamics over finite intervals ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . SpecCTMC evaluates tentative future states together while preserving the joint law of event times, positions, and tokens.

blocks.en: Parallel masked decoders reduce model evaluations by committing several tokens from one set of predictions. Fast-dLLM and Fast-dLLM++ select updates by confidence, EB-Sampler uses entropy bounds, and PUNT tests approximate conditional independence ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Kasa et al., 2026 ; Ben-Hamu et al., 2025 ; Azangulov et al., 2026 ) . Schedule analyses characterize the resulting dependency error, while DEMASK and SIRS use learned influence estimates or rejection sampling to control it ( Chen et al., 2025 ; Ringel et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Self Speculative Decoding reproduces a deterministic stepwise reference; Spiffy, Parallel Speculative Decoding, and trajectory-level speculation draft future denoising states under method-specific exactness conditions or measured speed and quality tradeoffs ( Gao et al., 2025 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . Self-Speculative Masked Diffusions instead train a hybrid causal and noncausal architecture ( Campbell et al., 2026 ) . SpecCTMC uses previously computed predictions only to draft tentative marks. Target verification and positive-residual correction then preserve DirectCTMC without additional training or a separate drafter.

blocks.en: Exact speculative sampling has been developed for continuous diffusion transitions on fixed denoising schedules, with block verification improving progress across proposed transitions ( Bortoli et al., 2025 ; Soen et al., 2026 ) . AutoSpec uses exchangeable increments to parallelize continuous diffusion without a separate draft model ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . Autospeculation and Any-Subset Speculative Decoding obtain exact parallel samples from compatible conditional-marginal or joint-density oracles, and related theory parallelizes single-site dynamics under influence conditions ( Anari et al., 2026 ; Guo and Ermon, 2026 ; Liu and Yin, 2025 ) . Temporal-point-process methods likewise draft and verify marked event sequences ( Gong et al., 2025 ; Biloš et al., 2025 ) . SpecCTMC requires normalized state-dependent transition rows, but not globally compatible denoiser conditionals. For absorbing-mask models, correcting a proposed position and token leaves the future event clock valid, which permits exact speculation over the complete marked CTMC path. Table 1 summarizes these distinctions; appendix E gives the detailed comparisons.
blocks.zh: 为在固定的取消提名时间表上持续进行扩散过渡,开发了精确的投机性取样,在拟议的过渡中进行块状核查,改善进展(Bortoli等人,2025;Soen等人,2026)。 AutoSpec使用可交换增量来平行地进行连续扩散,而无需单独的草稿模型(Hu等,2025.). 自动投机和Any-Subset Speculative Decoding从相容的有条件-边际或相通密度甲骨文中获取精确的平行样本,相关理论在影响条件下将单站点动态平行(Anari等,2026;Guo和Ermon,2026;Liu和Yin,2025.). 同样,还起草和核实了标记事件序列(Gong等人,2025年;Biloš等人,2025年)。 SpecCTMC要求国家依赖的正态过渡行,但并非全球相容的denoiser条件. 对于吸收-掩码模型,纠正一个拟议位置和令牌使未来事件时钟有效,从而可以精确地推测完整的标有CTMC路径. 表1概述了这些区别;附录E提供了详细的比较。

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Exact speculative simulation of one marked CTMC block.
blocks.zh: 算法 1 精确推测模拟一个有标记的 CTMC 块.

blocks.en:
SpecCTMC applies exact speculative decoding to the event-driven masked diffusion process described in Section 3 . As previously established, the event time distribution depends only on model time and the number of remaining masks. SpecCTMC therefore samples all event times before generating their marks and speculates only over the position-token marks.
Each speculative round drafts a tentative trajectory, evaluates the target distributions at the states before the proposed updates, and verifies the proposed marks in sequence. In our implementation, the drafter selects a masked position uniformly and samples its replacement token from a mixture of the previously computed target probabilities at that position and a uniform distribution over tokens other than the mask token. Appendix F gives the mixture weight and cache details. At the first rejection, SpecCTMC samples a corrected mark from the residual correction distribution and starts a new round from the corrected state.

SpecCTMC对第3节所描述的事件驱动口罩扩散过程应用了精确的投机解码. 如之前所确定,事件时间分布仅取决于模型时间和所剩口罩的数量. 因此,SpecCTMC在产生其标记之前,会对所有事件进行取样,并且只猜测位置-指针标记.
每轮推测起草一个暂定轨迹,在拟议更新之前评估各州的目标分布,并按顺序核实拟议标记. 在执行过程中,起草者统一选择一个被遮住的位置,并从该位置上先前计算的目标概率的混合物中取出其替换信号,并在遮住信号以外的标志上统一分配。 附 录 F给出了混合物重量和缓存细节. 在第一次拒绝时,SpecCTMC从剩余更正分布中取出一个被更正的标记并开始从被更正的状态取出一发新发.

blocks.en: 5 Theoretical Analysis
blocks.zh: 5 理论分析

blocks.en: We establish that SpecCTMC preserves the joint distribution of event times, position-token marks, and resulting states generated by DirectCTMC. The argument has two parts: (1) correcting a proposed mark leaves the event-time distribution unchanged, and (2) verification with residual correction produces marks with the target conditional distribution. We then characterize the number of speculative rounds and target evaluations, and relate this cost to proposal quality.
blocks.zh: 我们确定,SpecCTMC保留了事件时间、位置标记和DirectCTMC产生的结果状态的联合分布。 论证有两部分:(1)更正所拟标记后,事件-时间分布不变;(2)用剩余修正进行核查,产生标记并附有目标有条件分布. 然后,我们确定投机性轮次和目标评价的数目,并将这一费用与提案质量挂钩。

approximation. SpecCTMC instead reduces sequential evaluations while
preserving the underlying CTMC distribution. We give the solver
constructions and implementation details in Section D.5 .

blocks.en: Token temperature controls the token sampled at a selected position, while position temperature controls the order in which masked positions are unmasked. Mean accuracy over K K attempts averages correctness across all generated answers through attempt K K . Pass@ K K is the percentage of evaluation problems solved at least once. Variation in unmasking order can restore Pass@ K K scaling and improve coverage at a matched evaluation budget ( Olausson et al., 2026 ) . The temperature that gives the best coverage can also change with the number of attempts ( Lamont et al., 2026 ) . These results motivate exact acceleration of stochastic sampling. Approximate acceleration can change the chosen sampling distribution. SpecCTMC reduces sequential target-model evaluations while preserving the complete CTMC sampling law at each fixed temperature.

blocks.en: 7 Limitations and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 限制和结论

blocks.en: SpecCTMC reduces sequential target-model evaluations for the natural-event CTMC induced by an unchanged masked denoiser, while exact verification and positive-residual correction preserve DirectCTMC’s event-time and mark law. Our experiments on LLaDA and Dream show lower latency across most measured conditions without a separate draft model, and the cache experiment shows that SpecCTMC composes with cache reuse. The method complements other exact CTMC simulators. Uniformization replaces state-dependent event rates with a dominating Poisson clock and virtual self-transitions, and has been developed for reverse discrete diffusion without time-discretization error ( Chen and Ying, 2024 ) . A matched comparison can determine when its virtual-event cost is preferable to SpecCTMC’s additional target rows.
blocks.zh: SpecCTMC减少了对未变的蒙面阴茎所引发的自然活动CTMC的相继目标模型评价,而精确的核查和正-剩余修正则保留了DirectCTMC的事件时间和标记法. 我们关于LLaDA和Dream的实验显示,在大多数测量条件下,没有单独的草稿模型的潜伏度较低,缓存实验显示SpecCTMC以缓存再利用来作曲. 该方法补充了其他精确的CTMC模拟器. 统一取而代之的是状态依赖的事件率,取而代之的是占上风的普瓦生时钟和虚拟自相过渡,并被开发为逆向离散扩散而无时间分解错误(Chen and Ying, 2024). 相匹配的比较可以确定它的虚拟活动成本何时比SpecCTMC的额外目标行更好.

blocks.en: For SpecCTMC, elapsed time depends on sequence length, memory, and the target model’s batch-cost curve because rows after the first rejection may be unused ( Sadhukhan et al., 2025 ; Ho et al., 2026 ) ; our hardware study quantifies these effects in Section D.3 . The influence condition in Theorem 2 gives a sufficient condition for long accepted prefixes and linear expected target-row work ( Liu and Yin, 2025 ) . Larger changes in the remaining token predictions can reduce acceleration, but they do not affect the path-law guarantee in Theorem 1 . These results establish exact speculative batching as a practical way to exchange parallel target work for lower sequential depth while preserving the chosen stochastic decoding process.
blocks.zh: 对SpecCTMC来说,过去的时间取决于序列长度、内存以及目标模型的批量成本曲线,因为第一次拒绝之后的行可能会被使用(Sadhukhan等人,2025年;Ho等人,2026年;我们的硬件研究在D.3节中将这些效果量化了。 定理2的影响力条件为被长期接受的前缀和线性预期目标行工作提供了足够条件(刘和殷,2025. 余下符号预测值的较大变化可以降低加速,但不影响定理1中的路径法保证. 这些结果确立了精确的投机分批,作为将平行目标工作交换出更低相干深度的实用方法,同时保留所选择的分层解码过程.

blocks.en: Impact Statement
blocks.zh: 影响说明

blocks.en: This work develops an inference algorithm for sampling from a fixed diffusion language model more efficiently under explicit mathematical conditions. Faster generation can reduce latency and accelerator use for applications that already deploy these models. It can also lower the cost of producing low-quality, misleading, or harmful text. The method does not change model weights, training data, or safety behavior, so it neither removes nor introduces content safeguards by itself. Deployments remain responsible for model selection, access controls, output evaluation, and monitoring. Our restricted code evaluation executes generated programs under process, memory, time, import, file, and network limits rather than treating unrestricted execution as a benchmark convenience.
blocks.zh: 这项工作为在明确的数学条件下更有效地从固定扩散语言模型中取样开发出推论算法。 更快的生成可以减少已部署这些模型的应用程序的延迟和加速器使用. 它还能降低制作低质量、误导或有害文字的成本。 该方法并不改变模型的权重,训练数据,或安全行为,因此它既不自行去除也不引入内容保障. 部署部门仍负责模式选择、访问控制、产出评价和监测。 我们的受限代码评价在进程,内存,时间,导入,文件和网络限制下执行生成的程序,而不是将不受限制的执行作为基准方便.

blocks.en: The primary study uses the public LLaDA-8B-Instruct ( Nie et al., 2025 ) and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B ( Ye et al., 2025 ) checkpoints. GSM8K uses five demonstrations, MATH four demonstrations from the minerva_math configuration, MBPP three demonstrations, and HumanEval and IFEval none; the complete sequence length therefore differs widely across benchmarks at the same generated length. Every model, benchmark, and generated-length condition uses the same fixed evaluation set and five sampling seeds per method. HumanEval and MBPP use the Fast-dLLM code extraction followed by the official benchmark tests in an isolated process with time and memory limits; parse failures, test failures, and timeouts count as incorrect. LLaDA-V uses fixed image conditioning on MathVerse and MathVista with 4,096 validated generations; its task scores are not reported because the required hosted evaluator was unavailable.
blocks.zh: 主要研究使用公共LLaDA-8B-Instruct(Nie等,2025年)和Dream-v0-Instruct-7B(Ye等,2025年)检查站. GSM8K使用了5个演示,MATH来自Minerva_math配置的4个演示,MBPP的3个演示,以及HumanEval和IFEval的0个演示;因此,完整的序列长度在相同的生成长度上在基准上有很大的不同. 每个模型、基准和生成长度条件都采用相同的固定评价集和每种方法的5个取样种子。 HumanEval和MBPP在有时间和内存限制的孤立过程中使用快取dLLM代码提取,然后在官方基准测试中进行;解析失败,测试失败,以及超时计为不正确. LLaDA-V在 MathVerse 和 MathVista 上使用固定的图像配置,有4,096个经过验证的代;其任务分数没有报告,因为所需的主机评价员没有.

blocks.en: For every model, benchmark, and generated length, we compare depths 2 through 8 using warmed timing on a fixed selection set. The depth that minimizes SpecCTMC total generation time is used for the accuracy, NFE, and timing results of that condition. DirectCTMC evaluates one target state per call, while SpecCTMC evaluates a batch equal to its selected depth. Primary timing uses one exclusively held NVIDIA B200 with balanced method order; model loading and warmup are outside the measured interval, and total generation time includes drafting, target evaluation, verification, residual correction, host-device synchronization, and deterministic completion at the cutoff. The L40S measurements in Figures 3 and 3 use one NVIDIA L40S with 46 GiB of memory.
blocks.zh: 对于每个模型,基准, 和生成的长度, 我们比较深度2到8 使用温暖的时间 在固定的选择集。 将SpecCTMC的总生成时间最小化的深度用于该条件的准确性,NFE和计时结果. DirectCTMC评价每个呼叫一个目标状态,而SpecCTMC评价一个批次与其所选深度相等. 主要时间使用一个完全持有的有平衡方法顺序的NVIDIA B200;模型加载和热量在所测间隔之外,总生成时间包括起草,目标评价,校验,剩余校正,主机-设备同步,以及断接时的决定性完成. 图3和图3中的L40S测量使用一个有46个GiB的NVIDIA L40S.

blocks.en: Paired comparisons share the precomputed event-time sequence across methods. Target marks, proposal marks, acceptance tests, and residual samples use separate recorded random streams, so DirectCTMC and SpecCTMC need not produce identical answers. Accuracy and NFE intervals resample questions while keeping the five seeds nested within each question. Timing takes each method’s median over its three repetitions within a question, forms the ratio, and bootstraps over questions. A condition is classified as faster or slower only when the paired 95% interval of T D / T S T_{D}/T_{S} lies entirely above or below one; an interval containing one is parity. Accuracy difference always means SpecCTMC minus DirectCTMC.

blocks.zh: D.2 选择和卸下伪装的顺序

blocks.en:
Lowering token temperature improves the accuracy of an individual
stochastic answer, but it does not turn DirectCTMC or SpecCTMC into Greedy denoising. Each masked-diffusion update makes two decisions. It chooses which masked position to unmask and then chooses which token to place at that position. The experiment below tests all four combinations of uniform or confidence-based position choice and sampled or highest-probability token choice.
blocks.zh:
降低符号温度可以提高个人的准确性
斯多克特式的答案,但它并没有将 DirectCTMC 或 SpecCTMC 变成贪婪取乐. 每一次蒙面扩散更新都会做出两个决定. 它选择要解密的掩蔽位置, 然后选择要放置在该位置的符号 。 下面的实验测试了统一或基于信心的位置选择的所有四个组合,并抽样或最高概率的符号选择.

blocks.en: In this experiment, confidence-based unmasking order improves accuracy by 35.94 percentage points when tokens are sampled and by 53.13 points when the highest-probability token is used. The highest-probability token adds no measured improvement under uniform random unmasking order, but it adds 17.19 points under confidence-based unmasking order. Thus, the two choices interact, and the unmasking order accounts for most of the measured gap between stochastic CTMC sampling and Greedy denoising. Lower token temperature changes the token distribution while preserving the CTMC’s random unmasking order. Greedy denoising instead fixes both the position order and token choice. Random unmasking order lowers the measured single-answer accuracy in this comparison and permits different trajectories across repeated attempts. Section 6 reports the corresponding Pass@ K K results.

blocks.en: Bortoli et al. (2025) extend speculative sampling to continuous diffusion transitions on a fixed denoising schedule. Their method establishes the linear-draft pattern used here: draft future states, evaluate target transitions in parallel, verify a prefix, correct the first rejection, and discard the suffix. AutoSpec exploits exchangeable increments to parallelize continuous denoising diffusion probabilistic models without an auxiliary drafter ( Hu et al., 2025 ) . Both operate on continuous fixed-schedule diffusion rather than a discrete marked CTMC whose event times are sampled before its marks. Soen et al. (2026) develop efficient continuous residual sampling and joint block verification for speculative diffusions. Joint block verification also improves autoregressive speculative decoding ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . The contribution here is the marked event construction for an event-driven discrete process, including a random clock and a joint categorical position/token residual. We identify the absorbing-mask condition under which event times sampled before the marks remain valid after mark correction.

AutoSpec利用可交换增量,在没有辅助起草器的情况下平行地去诺能扩散概率模型(Hu等,2025年). 两者都以连续固定时间表扩散方式运作,而不是以离散标记的CTMC,其事件时间在标记之前取样。 苏能等. (2026) 发展高效的连续残留取样和对投机性扩散的联合区块核查. 联合区块核查还改进了自递性投机解码(Sun等人,2025年)。 这里的贡献是为事件驱动的离散过程构建的标志性事件结构,包括一个随机的时钟和一个联合的绝对位置/托盘剩余. 我们确定吸收-掩埋条件,在此条件下,在标记修正后,在标记之前取样的事件时间仍然有效。

blocks.en: Parallel masked-diffusion decoders select several positions from one model evaluation. Fast-dLLM and Fast-dLLM++ use confidence rules that mitigate dependency violations and can preserve a greedy mode under stated assumptions ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Kasa et al., 2026 ) . EB-Sampler controls an entropy-based proxy for dependence error, while PUNT tests approximate contextual independence ( Ben-Hamu et al., 2025 ; Azangulov et al., 2026 ) . None of these methods reconstructs the complete parallel update as the distribution of its sequential reference. Chen et al. (2025) characterize the expected Kullback-Leibler divergence of parallel masked sampling through the unmasking schedule and the target distribution’s information curve. Their result establishes the general dependence-loss mechanism. Ringel et al. (2026) train a pairwise influence predictor and, under a subadditivity assumption, choose blocks whose factorized update lies within a selected total-variation tolerance of the corresponding joint update. Zhang et al. (2026) use randomized rejection increments so that practical clipping replaces the full within-block dependence error with a bounded clipping term. Both control the parallel factorization error without universally eliminating it. SpecCTMC instead uses target evaluation and residual correction to preserve its declared transition kernel. Sequential first-hitting sampling (FHS), which DirectCTMC instantiates, exactly simulates the reverse CTMC one event at a time; its parallel variant uses the same first-hitting times while freezing predictions across several unmasking events and is explicitly an approximation ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) . Liang et al. (2026) prove in total variation that FHS adds no sampling error beyond score-estimation error, while finite-step Euler sampling has a separate discretization contribution. Table 1 compares where parallelism enters and whether each method preserves exact event times, the natural-event CTMC law, and its stated sequential reference.

SpecCTMC may use previously computed factorized predictions because they determine only tentative proposals. Sequential target verification and positive-residual correction over the complete position/token mark space remove the proposal bias, so the committed process adds no parallel factorization error to DirectCTMC.

blocks.en: Self Speculative Decoding reproduces its deterministic stepwise reference through hierarchical verification ( Gao et al., 2025 ) . Spiffy is lossless when its batched draft probabilities equal the corresponding vanilla probabilities; its practical simple-mask implementation for fully bidirectional LLaDA and Dream is described as near-lossless ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) . Spiffy uses the target model as its drafter and calibrates its directed draft graphs offline. Parallel Speculative Decoding constructs multi-depth drafts and selects the deepest draft consistent with updated predictions, reporting a speed and quality tradeoff rather than equality with a stochastic CTMC law ( Sun et al., 2026 ) . Trajectory-Level Speculative Decoding proves exactness for a restricted deterministic top-one setting with fixed cached states and no inter-block speculation, while its practical cross-block method permits trajectory drift ( Pan et al., 2026 ) . Self-Speculative Masked Diffusions trains a hybrid causal and noncausal architecture whose full-network conditionals define a new nonfactorized target ( Campbell et al., 2026 ) . Probability-ratio acceptance and residual resampling remove factorization error relative to that trained target. These methods establish single-model speculative decoding results for finite-step references, while SpecCTMC combines within-trajectory parallel verification with preservation of an unchanged denoiser’s natural-event CTMC law.

blocks.en: SpecCTMC does not require the denoiser’s per-position predictions across masking contexts to be conditional marginals of a single joint distribution. DirectCTMC and SpecCTMC target the sequential process specified by the state-dependent transition kernel. The exactness theorem therefore requires normalized transition rows but no compatible any-order conditional oracle.

blocks.en: Any-Subset Speculative Decoding samples from trained any-subset autoregressive models using their joint-density oracle ( Guo and Ermon, 2026 ) . Liu and Yin (2025) faithfully parallelize general single-site dynamics under influence conditions in a parallel random-access machine model. Under the bounded-unmasking-influence assumption, Theorem 2 bounds full-network target evaluations for the joint position/token proposal based on cached target predictions, with finite batch capacity. It permits normalized state-dependent predictions that need not be conditional marginals of a single joint distribution.

Our condition and correction differ: absorbing-mask intensity is independent of mark identities after conditioning on event count, so event times sampled before the marks remain valid after categorical position/token correction through maximal coupling.

blocks.en: Discrete diffusion has a standard CTMC formulation, commonly simulated through tau-leaping ( Campbell et al., 2022 ) . Uniformization can remove time-discretization error by introducing a common candidate clock with virtual self transitions ( Chen and Ying, 2024 ) . Higher-order Runge-Kutta and trapezoidal solvers improve approximation order ( Ren et al., 2025 ) . Uniformization provides an exact serial reference, whereas tau-leaping and higher-order solvers provide approximate comparisons. SpecCTMC instead couples a proposed embedded transition to the target transition and batches neural evaluations at states preceding the drafted updates.
blocks.zh: 散射有标准的CTMC配体,通常通过取出取出来模拟(Campbell等,2022年). 统一化可以通过引入一个具有虚拟自转功能的通用候选时钟(Chen and Ying, 2024.)来去除分时错误. 更高级的Runge-Kutta和tapezoidal溶液改进了近似顺序(Ren等人,2025年)。 统一提供了确切的系列参考,而取出取出和取出取出取出高等的解出器则提供了近似比较. SpecCTMC转而与拟议向目标过渡的嵌入式过渡相配对,并在起草更新之前在各州进行神经评价。

blocks.en: Our implementation drafts by reusing previously computed target token probabilities, without the need for an auxiliary model. At each tentative state, the proposal selects a masked position uniformly and samples a token from the reused probability vector for that position. For both checkpoints, we remove the mask-token probability before normalizing the remaining token probabilities. Dream applies the checkpoint’s one-position logit shift once before normalization.
blocks.zh: 我们通过重新使用先前计算的目标概率来起草执行草案,而不需要辅助模型。 在每一个暂定状态下,提案都统一选择一个被遮住的位置,并从该位置的再利用概率矢量中抽取一个符号。 对这两个检查站来说,在使剩余的象征性概率正常化之前,我们消除了口罩的概率。 梦想在正常化前一度应用检查站的一站式对帐转换。

blocks.en: Unless stated otherwise, we use temperature one, no classifier-free guidance, and cutoff ε = 0.01 \varepsilon=0.01 . The proposal mixes previously computed target probabilities with a uniform distribution over replacement tokens using weight 10 − 4 10^{-4} . The evaluation protocol, including depth selection, target-state grouping, timing, pairing, and code scoring, is described in Section D.1 .
blocks.zh: 除非另有说明,否则我们使用一号温度,不采用无分级制导,并截取QQ=0.01\varepsilon=0.01. 该提案将先前计算的目标概率与使用重量10 - 4 10 - 4 重的替换符号的统一分布相混合。 评价协议,包括深度选择、目标状态分组、计时、配对和代码评分,在D.1节中作了说明。

blocks.en: An initial target-model evaluation computes probabilities at the current state. Paired comparisons use the same event-time sequence across methods. Target-mark, draft-mark, verification, and residual draws use separate recorded random streams. Method order alternates across matched workloads.
blocks.zh: 初始目标模型评价计算出当前状态下的概率. Paired比较使用同一事件时间序列跨方法. 目标标记、草稿标记、核查和剩余绘图使用单独的记录随机流。 不同工作量的代号。

blocks.en: We follow the same procedure as described in ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Kasa et al., 2026 ) :GSM8K uses numeric exact extraction. MATH uses symbolic answer equivalence. MBPP and HumanEval use restricted execution that rejects unsafe or unsupported candidates and records the reason. IFEval uses the pinned first 300 prompts in source order, giving 456 instruction instances. Prompt-level strict accuracy is the task score. Strict and loose checkers receive identical deterministic prompt-derived random choices. Dream text projection preserves raw sampled identifiers and maps undefined tokenizer identifiers to the Unicode replacement character only in scorer input.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循与(Wu等,2026;Kasa等,2026)所述相同的程序:GSM8K使用数字精确取出. MATH使用符号式的答案等同. MBPP和HumanEval使用限制处决,拒绝不安全或不支持的候选人,并记录原因. 纵横 Eval按出处顺序使用被绑住的前300个提示,给出456个指令例. 即时级的严格精确度是任务分数. 严格和松散的检查器得到相同的确定性即时随机选择。 梦之文字投影仅以计分器输入的方式保留了原始的抽样标识符并将未定义的代号标识符映射到Unicode替换字符.
